Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising: first and second layers; a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer; a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer; [[an additional adhesive layer;]] wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are configured to be cured to each other; wherein the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers; a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are [[in registration with]] __aligned with__ the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer; and __wherein the medial section comprises a fiber reinforced plastic material__.

Claim 282 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

Claim 283 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

Claim 284 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 282 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281 further including __a segmented__ weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 286 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

Claim 287 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

Claim 288 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

Claim 289 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is segmented.

Claim 290 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

Claim 292 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 291 wherein the central opening accommodates a drive shaft.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281 further including __a segmented__ weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

Claim 294 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

Claim 295 (Previously presented): The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented.
